activities.prompt: What is the central scope of pathology?

options.text: Treatment decisions based on symptoms alone
options.evidence: Diagnosis also uses pathology tests, and pathology spans basic and clinical science.

options.text: Abnormalities causing loss of normal health
options.evidence: This defines disease rather than the discipline studying it.

options.text: The sequence of events in one disease mechanism
options.evidence: This specifically defines pathogenesis, a component of pathology.

options.text: Structural and functional changes underlying disease
options.evidence: Pathology studies disease patterns, causes, mechanisms and effects in cells, tissues and organs.

options.text: Structural alterations visible in diseased organs
options.evidence: This describes morphologic changes, only part of pathology.

explanation.en: Pathology bridges basic science and clinical practice by studying structural and functional changes underlying disease.
explanation.ar: يربط Pathology العلوم الأساسية بالممارسة السريرية بدراسة التغيرات البنيوية والوظيفية التي تقوم عليها الأمراض.

activities.prompt: Which pairing correctly distinguishes general from systemic pathology?

options.text: General: endocrine diseases; systemic: universal injury reactions
